_doc: Scenarios for the Tasan day-28 alert + nurse navigator. Effects reduce referral->treatment days for patients still untreated at the alert day. 'zero_effect' runs the full intervention code path with a 0-day effect and must reproduce baseline.

scenarios.label: Day-28 alert + navigator, NO effect
scenarios.source: Battaglia TA et al. 2016 (recs/top3.md): navigation had no effect at 60/180 days; always shown

scenarios.label: Alert + navigator, low what-if (-12 days)
scenarios.source: Cheema PK et al. 2017 (recs/top3.md): time to first-line therapy 36 -> 24 days (reflex EGFR/ALK). ASSUMPTION: effect_transfer

scenarios.label: Alert + navigator, mid what-if (-16 days)
scenarios.source: Hiu Nian Chung J et al. 2025 (recs/top3.md): referral -> decision to treat 20 -> 4 days (one-stop clinic). ASSUMPTION: effect_transfer

scenarios.label: Alert + navigator, high what-if (-24 days, 95% CI 12-35)
scenarios.source: Ezer N et al. 2017 (recs/top3.md): time to first treatment -24 days (95% CI 12-35), rapid investigation clinic. ASSUMPTION: effect_transfer

scenarios.label: Mid what-if + crowding-out of non-alerted patients
scenarios.source: Olsson O 2020 (recs/top3.md) for direction; magnitude is ASSUMPTION crowding_extra_days
